matrix.scope: Read-only inspection of completed local unsigned CPU/CUDA package switching matrix; no reviewer Docker/GPU/package execution or release acceptance.

limits: Same recorded historical builder images; no independent OS-image or dependency source reconstruction.
Unsigned CUDA package reproducibility only; no deterministic signing, physical-device, installed lifecycle or publication claim.
reproducibility.method: Read and compare both complete byte streams directly in 8 MiB chunks, also compute SHA256; no normalization or excluded bytes.

reproducibility_independent_readback.method: Independent direct byte-stream and SHA256/size comparison of all eight output files; seven receipt/log files rehashed; detached tracked source verified clean.
reproducibility_independent_readback.scope: Same recorded builders, unsigned CUDA only; installation/GPU acceptance is separate.

validation.scoped_audit: No known dependency/source findings in the scoped CI audit; not a general native dependency or public launch security assessment.

distribution_size.status: Current CUDA DEB exceeds GitHub release-asset limit; compression/public distribution remains separate.

result.scope: Compression feasibility only; same reviewed staging, no candidate installation/execution or release qualification.

compression_experiment.scope: Experimental re-encoding of the unchanged level-8 staging tree; not a source-bound production recipe change, installed/GPU-qualified replacement, signature or publication. The six-run matrix used only the original packages.

preserved_first_attempt.failure: 64 MiB temporary filesystem filled while dpkg-deb spooled compressed member data; retry used task-local disk scratch.

result.scope: Compression feasibility only; same reviewed staging, no candidate installation/execution or release qualification.

distribution_size.next_step: Commit reviewed compression and release-size policy, build new source-bound artifacts and qualify those exact bytes; do not replace the completed matrix inputs with the experimental package.

limits: Recorded historical builder images reused; no independent OS/toolchain/dependency source reconstruction.
Only the recorded Ubuntu24.04/Fedora44 amd64 fixtures and NVIDIA driver595.91.07 with the selected RTX3080/RTX5070 are exercised.
Hardware results prove bounded ONNX/CuPy execution, not camera/microphone, sustained processing, measured FPS, alternate drivers or other GPU architectures.
Fresh CPU-to-CUDA-to-CPU switching only; no legacy online-package CUDA migration, interrupted CUDA switch, clean VM or abrupt power-loss acceptance added.
Unsigned local packages; no protected hosted CUDA signing/provenance, production activation/default recipe change or release publication.
CPU/CUDA locks and source are exact; this is not a dependency upgrade or a new public application version.
Installed Snap190, frozen public v1.5.3 assets and host user settings/devices were not changed.
evidence_paths_relative_to: Original workspace parent containing the named worktrees; immutable source/recipe commits and receipt hashes bind local evidence.
